data.text:
Shv Shankar Sahu vs State Of U.P. on 20 March, 2024 
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
? Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:50953
Court No. - 52 
Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 2427 of 2024 
Petitioner :- Shv Shankar Sahu
Respondent :- State of U.P. 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Abhay Raj Yadav,Neeraj Pandey,Shilpa Singh Sikarwar 
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
2.  The instant writ petition has been filed for following relief:
" i) Issue an appropriate direction to the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Prayagraj to decide the prayer for the interim relief in the Food Safety Appeal No. 52 of 2021 (Shiv Shankar Sahu Versus State of U.P.) at the earliest, preponing the date already fixed in the said appeal."
3. Contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that an application for interim relief in the appeal filed by the petitioner is pending. It is further submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that opposite party has appeared before the court below. He prayed that the same may be decided,
expeditiously. 
4. In view of above, no useful purpose would be served in keeping this petition pending. 
Shv Shankar Sahu vs State Of U.P. on 20 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26202838/
1 5. Accordingly, the present petition stands disposed of finally with a direction to the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Prayagraj to consider and decide the application for interim relief, in accordance with law, expeditiously, preferably within a period of eight weeks from the date of production of a certified copy of this order after giving opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned and without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties provided that there is no other legal impediment. 
Order Date :- 20.3.2024 Nitika Sri. (Manish Kumar Nigam,J.)
